name: apollo
description: Pointer-only preset for projects using Apollo Client. Surfaces the canonical Apollo skill suite (`apollographql/skills`, MIT) at install time on projects whose `package.json` contains `"@apollo/client"`. The vendor's skill suite covers Apollo Client, Apollo Server 5, Apollo Connectors, Federation 2, and Apollo Kotlin — but this preset detects on the client package (the most common entry point); server-side and Kotlin uses are listed in `outOfScope` because the strict 1-entry detect rule (EF-005) forces a choice. Server-side Apollo users still benefit from the recipe entry pointer, just not from auto-detection. Apollo GraphQL Inc. is independent (no vendor-neutrality concern). See `docs/recipes/recommended-vendor-skills.md` §Apollo GraphQL and `specs/presets-vendor-pointer-tier/spec.md` for the tier semantics.

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Canonical Apollo skill suite from Apollo GraphQL Inc., covering Apollo Client, Apollo Server 5, Apollo Connectors, Federation 2, and Apollo Kotlin. Verified via `gh api repos/apollographql/skills` on 2026-05-19 — 72★, last commit 2026-05-14, MIT, not archived. Pair with claude-base's `dev-graphql` skill (schema design, DataLoader, N+1 prevention, security).

outOfScope: Foundation skill curation — no `foundation.skills.keep/drop` filter (vendor-pointer tier)
Opinionated install-time defaults — inherited from foundation defaults

Server-side Apollo (`@apollo/server`, `@apollo/server-*`, `@apollo/gateway`) — not auto-detected here per the strict 1-entry detect rule (EF-005). The vendor's skill suite still covers Apollo Server 5 and Federation 2; install manually via the recipe pointer or wait for a hypothetical follow-up `apollo-server` preset
Apollo Kotlin (`apollo-kotlin`) — out of scope (mobile / JVM stack, not JavaScript)
Non-Apollo GraphQL stacks (Yoga, Pothos, Mercurius, Strawberry, gqlgen) — claude-base's `dev-graphql` skill covers those
